name: Will my insurance cover emergency water cleanup services?

mainEntity.name: Will my insurance cover emergency water cleanup services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or appliance malfunction. However, coverage often excludes damage from floods (which requires separate flood insurance) or neglect, like long-term leaks. It's essential to review your specific policy or contact your insurance provider immediately after discovering water damage to understand your coverage details, deductible, and claims process. We can assist with documentation for your insurance claim.
